kept: Never print, persist, or embed passwords.
Publish, delete, or replace remote records only when authorized.
Ask before pushing to any remote branch.
Do not commit .env files or API keys.
Ask the owner first before running database migrations.
Never run rm -rf outside the build directory.
Get approval before sending external messages on the user's behalf.
Do not log tokens or personal data.
Deploy to production only from a tagged release.
Stay inside the sandbox; do not change file permissions.
Never rewrite the history of a shared branch.
Preserve changes already in the working tree. Do not revert unrelated dirty files.
open: Declare variables in src/ files with `const`, or `let` when they are reassigned; never use `var`.
Compare values in src/ files with `===` and `!==`, never `==` or `!=`.
Prefer early returns over nested conditionals.
